title: Calibration: a known signal
prompt: (calibration fixture -- the scripted adapter ignores this)

iterations.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1'); if (!h) return false; const m = getComputedStyle(h).color.match(/\d+/g); if (!m) return false; const [r,g,b] = m.map(Number); return b > 90 && b > r + 25 && b > g + 15; })()
